name: ICPL-356-50CEAXW
title: ICPL-356 series: phototransistor optocoupler, 3750 Vrms, 80 V VCEO, CTR ranks A/B/C, SOP4
summary: A single-channel optocoupler: an AlGaAs infrared LED shining on a silicon planar NPN phototransistor, in a low-profile four-lead SOP4 with a coplanar double-mold body. Isolation is 3750 Vrms for one minute, the output stands 80 V collector to emitter, and the part runs from -40 °C to 110 °C. Three current transfer ratio ranks are sold, A (80-160 %), B (130-260 %) and C (200-400 %), all at IF = 5 mA, VCE = 5 V.

circuits.title: Test circuit for response time
circuits.description: Measures the rise, fall, turn-on and turn-off times. A current pulse IF enters the LED at the anode; the cathode returns to ground through RIN, and the cathode node is the input sense point. The collector is pulled up to VCC through the load RL and is the output sense point; the emitter is grounded. The output falls while the input pulse is high. tr and tf are the 90 %-to-10 % and 10 %-to-90 % transitions of the output; ton runs from the input rising edge to the output reaching 10 %, and toff from the input falling edge to the output reaching 90 %. The response-time rows are specified at VCE = 2 V, IC = 2 mA, RL = 100 Ω.

parts.note: load resistor, 100 Ω for the response-time rows

circuits.title: Test circuit for frequency response
circuits.description: Measures the frequency response. A source supplying a DC bias with an AC signal on top drives the LED anode; its return and the bottom of RIN, which sits between the cathode and ground, share ground. The collector is pulled up to VCC through RL and is the output sense point; the emitter is grounded. The cut-off frequency row is the -3 dB point at VCE = 2 V, IC = 2 mA, RL = 100 Ω.

parts.note: load resistor, 100 Ω for the cut-off frequency row

operation.text: An AlGaAs infrared emitting diode lights a silicon planar phototransistor across the isolation gap. The SOP4 body uses a coplanar double-mold structure for isolation stability. DC input, transistor output.
The rank letter in the part number selects the current transfer ratio at IF = 5 mA, VCE = 5 V: A 80-160 %, B 130-260 %, C 200-400 %.

Allowed LED forward current is 60 mA up to 25 °C ambient and falls linearly to about 9 mA at 110 °C. Allowed collector power dissipation is 150 mW up to 25 °C and falls linearly to about 23 mW at 110 °C.

With the collector loaded by RL, the output goes low while the LED is on. tr is the output transition from 90 % to 10 % and tf from 10 % to 90 %; ton is measured from the input rising edge to the output at 10 %, and toff from the input falling edge to the output at 90 %.
UL 1577; VDE to EN60747-5-5 (VDE0884-5); CQC to GB4943.1. REACH compliant, halogen free, moisture sensitivity level 1.
Three lines on the top: ICPL (company abbreviation); 356 followed by the CTR rank letter; then / (ISOMICRON), a two-digit fiscal year YY, a two-digit work week WW and a code letter A to Z.
Tape and reel on 13-inch reels of 3000; two reels to an inner box and five inner boxes to an outer box, 30,000 units.

Wave soldering follows JESD22-A111 with a solder temperature of 260 +0/-5 °C for 10 s. Hand soldering: 380 +0/-5 °C for at most 3 s. A single soldering pass is the recommendation for every method, and IR reflow is limited to three passes. The body should not be dipped into solder paste.
The characteristic curves are typical performance and are not guaranteed.
Programmable controllers, office equipment, household appliances and switching power supplies.
The package surface can discolour after soldering, reflow or long service; this has no effect on performance or reliability.
